newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy diesel, jet fuel for Dec.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy diesel, jet fuel for Dec.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy diesel and jet fuel for December 12-13 delivery, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 120,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 80,000 barrels of aviation jet fuel.
The tender closes at 1520 hours, Sri Lanka time on November 13 and offers are valid for two days.

In its last tender which was awarded to Caltex Bahrain, CPC bought 160,000 barrels of 0.5-percent sulphur diesel at $1.77 per barrel over Singapore spot quotes, and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel at a $1.40-per-barrel premium. The combination cargo is for November 24-25 delivery to Colombo on a c-and-f basis and to Trincomalee at a later date.
